text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Kita-chanâª You've been 
celebrating with me ever since we were 
little, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Alright, for the rest, let's keep the 
annual tradition going... and head over to 
my family's place!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks for inviting me again this 
year! A birthday party at a huge 
mansion...! It feels just like a festival, 
I'm so excited~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Both Father and Mother are really 
looking forward to hearing you sing, 
Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'd even go as far as bringing Kita-chan 
up onto our garden event stage, after all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I'm happy to hear that, but 
Dia-chan's father previously told me—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
When they asked me, "Would you like to 
sing the theme song for the Satono 
Group?", I was so surprised.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You must've been deeply moved, given 
how intensely dedicated you were back 
then~

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still, now that we're at the academy and 
performing on real stages, why not think 
about it seriously?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh!? Aren't we getting further and 
further away from celebrating Dia-chan?!
